corrections.en: He set off on the dun-bay horse,
corrections.note: Уй күрөң is a dun/ox-brown horse color here; тартып жөнөлүп describes setting off.

corrections.en: Struck from the vulnerable flank,
corrections.note: Restores the battle formula; кыймалуу refers to an exposed/vulnerable side.

corrections.en: “Struck from the vulnerable flank,
corrections.note: Restores the opening quotation and battle formula.

corrections.en: Leaning upon the dun-bay horse,
corrections.note: Retains жөлөнүп ‘leaning’ rather than copying the жөнөлүп parallel.

corrections.en: Struck from the vulnerable flank,
corrections.note: Restores the repeated battle formula.

corrections.en: Struck from the vulnerable flank,
corrections.note: Restores the repeated battle formula.

corrections.en: Scarcely had forty days passed,
corrections.note: Context is the early period of Kanykei’s widowhood; preserves кырк.

corrections.en: Back then, when black ice lay in great sheets,
corrections.note: Renders кечээ and the image калдайлуу кара муз rather than repeating ‘ice’.

corrections.en: That Bukhara lying yonder—
corrections.note: Restores the named place and demonstrative sense; жылма баскан remains textually uncertain.

corrections.en: The Muslim who gathered the forty companions at his death.
corrections.note: Restores кырк чоро and the death setting.

corrections.en: “Take your mother eighty times over, wrestler!”
corrections.note: Preserves the insulting imperative and сексен; idiom remains coarse and uncertain.

corrections.en: When the turn of the eight khans came,
corrections.note: Preserves сегиз кан; чарчысы is read contextually as a turn/occasion.

corrections.en: I mourn for the white palace,
corrections.note: Restores муңкаганым as the object of lament.

corrections.en: When black ice lay in great sheets,
corrections.note: Repairs the tautological first pass.

corrections.en: Its broad crupper flaring,
corrections.note: The surrounding lines describe the horse Maaniker; карабжы is treated as horse tack, not a gaze.

corrections.en: I mourn for the white palace,
corrections.note: Restores the lament construction.

corrections.en: Scraping the horse’s fetlock,
corrections.note: Literal best-effort rendering of ат томук + сыдырып.

corrections.en: Gathering sixty households as hostages,
corrections.note: Restores алтымыш and reads ак үйлүү in its political-hostage sense.

corrections.en: How can I saddle him, dividing the gear into ten?
corrections.note: Restores он бөлүп and the horse-tack verb токунам; syntax remains uncertain.

corrections.en: One prince’s attendant,
corrections.note: Removes the invented insult; боочу is an uncertain occupational/retainer term.

corrections.en: Poor soul, on fourteen camels,
corrections.note: Restores он төрт төөгө; the line is syntactically dependent on its surrounding passage.

corrections.en: Hero, I was the bridegroom who came that once.
corrections.note: Preserves баатыр, күйө, and бир келген; speaker/idiom merits later specialist review.

corrections.en: For sixty—and forty sheep—
corrections.note: Restores both numerals and retains the line’s continuation into the purchased dagger.

corrections.en: After waiting a full six days,
corrections.note: Restores алты күн; аа is treated as emphatic/interjectional noise.

corrections.en: Propping him upon the dun-bay horse,
corrections.note: Uses causative жөлөнтүп and the horse-color phrase.

corrections.en: Its young to Manas
corrections.note: Restores Manas; the phrase continues syntactically into the following sacrifice line.

corrections.en: My child Kanykei began the turmoil,
corrections.note: Restores Kanykei and дүмөк ‘turmoil’.

corrections.en: Struck from the vulnerable flank,
corrections.note: Restores the repeated battle formula.

corrections.en: May God now strike all sixty,
corrections.note: Restores алтымыш and the optative curse.

corrections.en: To a pass six months’ journey away,
corrections.note: Restores алты айчылык and кезең ‘pass’.

corrections.en: He ranged them through five or six summer pastures.
corrections.note: Restores both numerals and жай ‘summer pasture’.

corrections.en: My doubled, trailing fringes,
corrections.note: жырымы is treated as a slit/fringe rather than a song; exact costume term remains uncertain.

corrections.en: The cutting rite she performed for me,
corrections.note: Here кыркып is the verb ‘cut,’ not the numeral forty.

corrections.en: The standard-winner raised his banner,
corrections.note: Restores the туу/standard wordplay and removes the birthday hallucination.

corrections.en: You let it be struck from the flank,
corrections.note: Context refers to possessions; preserves the causative second-person verb.

corrections.en: You let it be struck in a treacherous place,
corrections.note: Distinguishes кыялы жерде from the similar flank formula.

corrections.en: I mourn for the white palace,
corrections.note: Restores the lament construction.

corrections.en: Alöökö with six thousand champions
corrections.note: Restores both the number and participant; the phrase continues into the next line.
